name: guarantee-card
title: Guarantee card
description: One guarantee: statement, check, deadline, remedy and status.

files.content:
import type { GuaranteeCardProps } from '../schemas' import { cx } from './util' const TONE = { honored: 'good', remedied: 'good', pending: undefined, breached: 'bad' } as const const WORD = { honored: 'Honored', remedied: 'Breached, remedy delivered', pending: 'Pending', breached: 'Breached, remedy outstanding' } as const export function GuaranteeCard({ id, statement, check, deadlineHours, remedy, status, detail, className }: GuaranteeCardProps & { className?: string }) { return (
{id} {WORD[status]}

{statement}

Checked by
{check}
{deadlineHours !== undefined && ( <>
Deadline
{deadlineHours} hours
)}
If missed
{remedy}
{detail && ( <>
Latest
{detail}
)}
) }
